svg.title: Nomad event-driven architecture
svg.desc: Event-driven architecture for HashiCorp Nomad: multiple producers emit Evaluation events into the EvalBroker priority queue; Server Worker goroutines dequeue and invoke Scheduler implementations asynchronously; plans are submitted back to the leader; clients react to allocation events via heartbeat. Producers and consumers are fully decoupled through the evaluation event bus.

g.text: Event producers — emit Evaluation objects on every state change

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How does job submission produce an Evaluation in Nomad?')

sendPrompt('How does the deployment watcher produce Evaluations?')
sendPrompt('How does the EvalBroker work in Nomad?')
g.text: In-memory priority queue on leader · at-least-once delivery · Ack / Nack semantics

sendPrompt('What does the Core scheduler handle?')
sendPrompt('How does the Nomad leader apply a scheduler Plan?')
g.text: Evaluate plan · commit allocations to state store · Ack evaluation

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How do Nomad clients react to allocation events?')
g.text: React to allocation events · launch tasks · report health back to server

svg.text: Producers and consumers fully decoupled — all coordination mediated through the EvalBroker event bus
